name: sentiment-color-words
title: Sentiment Color Words
description: A sentiment readout where each word is tinted by its valence score on a diverging scale — negative cools, positive warms — with a hover tooltip exposing the exact score and a legend that doubles as the scale.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Medium
Shape: Soft
Motion: None
Typography: Humanist
Color: Duotone

## Rules

- Hover Readout: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
